machineArchitectures.name: Modular Vertical Grid Ice Machine (Commercial Cuber)
machineArchitectures.aerosolizationPotential: Moderate (Harvest hot gas bypass creates brief vapor purge)
machineArchitectures.description: Standard commercial restaurant ice maker. Water cascades over vertical nickel-plated grids. Cold temperatures (0°C to 4°C) inhibit mesophiles but provide an ideal psychrophilic biofilm niche on distribution manifolds and plastic splash curtains.

machineArchitectures.name: Undercounter Bar & Beverage Ice Maker (High Airborne Yeast Exposure)
machineArchitectures.aerosolizationPotential: High (Internal air circulation pulls ambient beer/sugar aerosols into sump)
machineArchitectures.evaporatorMetallurgy: Tin-plated or stainless steel vertical grid with plastic sump
machineArchitectures.description: Installed beneath bars and coffee counters. Operates in close proximity to draught beer taps, fermenting syrups, and bakery flour. Airborne Saccharomyces and wild yeasts settle into the warm compressor air intake, causing rapid slimy biofilm blooms in under 14 days.

machineArchitectures.name: Commercial Flaker / Nugget Extruder (Continuous Auger Drive)
machineArchitectures.aerosolizationPotential: High (Continuous mechanical auger scraping generates microscopic moisture droplets)
machineArchitectures.evaporatorMetallurgy: Stainless steel cylindrical freeze barrel with brass/bronze auger bearings
machineArchitectures.description: Continuous scraping ice extruder common in hospitals, seafood displays, and salad bars. High shear friction and inaccessible evaporator freeze barrels provide harborage sites for Listeria monocytogenes and Pseudomonas aeruginosa biofilms.

machineArchitectures.name: Domestic Countertop Portable Ice Maker (Recirculating Reservoir)
machineArchitectures.aerosolizationPotential: Very High (Ultrasonic or open-fan agitator without drain line recirculates stagnant water)
machineArchitectures.evaporatorMetallurgy: Bare aluminum or chrome-plated finger freeze pins with silicone tubing
machineArchitectures.description: Compact home appliance without permanent plumbing or drain lines. Stagnant meltwater drains back into the lower reservoir, continuously recycling bacteria, sloughed human skin flakes, and psychrophilic spores through an uninsulated pump.

sanitationMaintenanceLevels.name: Weekly NSF/ANSI-12 Compliant Sanitation (Descaling + EPA Biocide Flush)
sanitationMaintenanceLevels.slimeVisual: Zero visible residue. Mirror-clean metal and clear plastic curtain.
sanitationMaintenanceLevels.description: Full disassembly, acid descaling of mineral scale followed by 200 ppm sodium hypochlorite or quaternary ammonium biocide flush. Biofilm EPS cannot establish anchorage.

sanitationMaintenanceLevels.name: Monthly Routine Cleaning (Manufacturer Recommended Minimum)
sanitationMaintenanceLevels.slimeVisual: Faint matte sheen on water curtain and distribution tube nozzles.
sanitationMaintenanceLevels.description: Meets FDA Food Code baseline. Microscopic conditioning film of organic macromolecules and pioneer Pseudomonas colonies. Heterotrophic plate count remains below the 500 CFU/mL EPA drinking water limit.

sanitationMaintenanceLevels.name: Neglected 90-Day Uncleaned (Active Slime Growth)
sanitationMaintenanceLevels.biofilmStatus: Mature Structured Biofilm with Active Sloughing
sanitationMaintenanceLevels.slimeVisual: Yellowish-brown or pink gelatinous slime on splash curtain and water trough.
sanitationMaintenanceLevels.description: Thick Extracellular Polymeric Substance (EPS) matrix encasing dense colonies of Cladosporium mold, Methylobacterium, and Pseudomonas. Water shear breaks off clumps into freshly harvested ice cubes.

sanitationMaintenanceLevels.name: Severe 6+ Month Abandonment (Critical Biological Infestation)
sanitationMaintenanceLevels.slimeVisual: Thick black/green hairy mold patches, pungent musty odor, black flakes in ice cubes.
sanitationMaintenanceLevels.description: Severe health hazard. Multi-species biofilm consortium with Exophiala jeanselmei black yeast, Legionella pneumophila, and Aspergillus mold. Ice exceeds potable drinking water standards by 100-fold.

ambientEnvironmentAirTypes.name: HVAC Controlled Commercial Kitchen (Temperate & Dry)
ambientEnvironmentAirTypes.description: Positive pressure conditioned air. Baseline ambient spore loading. Ice machine condenser fan operates without pulling heavy food aerosol contaminants into the water trough.

ambientEnvironmentAirTypes.name: High-Airborne-Yeast Environment (Bar, Brewery, Bakery, Pizzeria)
ambientEnvironmentAirTypes.description: Air is saturated with volatile organic compounds, ethanol vapors, active brewer's yeast, and airborne flour dust. Microbes metabolize volatile alcohol vapors, multiplying biofilm accumulation rates by nearly 400%.

ambientEnvironmentAirTypes.name: Humid Warm Service Corridor / Unventilated Alcove
ambientEnvironmentAirTypes.description: Condenser exhaust recirculates in cramped enclosure. Ambient temperatures exceed 30°C, speeding psychrophilic condensation and supporting mold hyphae growth along all gasket seams.

ambientEnvironmentAirTypes.name: Residential Open Kitchen (Cooking Spatter & Humidity Fluctuations)
ambientEnvironmentAirTypes.description: Periodic humidity spikes from cooking and boiling. Airborne lipid aerosols provide organic nutrients that settle on the water trough surface.

waterFiltrationProtocols.name: Sub-Micron (0.2 µm) Carbon Block + Silver Ion Bacteriostatic Matrix
waterFiltrationProtocols.chlorineRemoval: Total (>99%) while preventing downstream microbial proliferation via silver ions

waterFiltrationProtocols.name: Standard 5-Micron Carbon Filter (Dechlorinated Water without Bacteriostat)
waterFiltrationProtocols.chlorineRemoval: Removes 95% of municipal disinfectant, leaving untreated water in warm sump to incubate

waterFiltrationProtocols.name: Direct Unfiltered Municipal Tap (Hard Water >180 mg/L CaCO3)
waterFiltrationProtocols.scaleInhibitionEffectiveness: None (Rapid porous limescale encrustation creates microscopic anchor points for biofilm)
waterFiltrationProtocols.chlorineRemoval: Residual municipal chlorine (0.5–1.5 ppm) offers weak disinfection but fails against mature EPS

sanitationProtocolChecklist.title: Discard All Ice & Shut Off Water Supply
sanitationProtocolChecklist.action: Empty the storage bin completely. Never attempt to clean an ice machine while retaining ice cubes intended for human consumption.

sanitationProtocolChecklist.title: Acid Descaling Flush (Nickel-Safe Sulfamic / Phosphoric Acid)
sanitationProtocolChecklist.action: Circulate nickel-safe descaler through the water freeze cycle for 15 minutes to dissolve calcium carbonate scale that shields biofilm anchor roots.

sanitationProtocolChecklist.title: Manual Disassembly & Physical Scrubbing of Contact Components
sanitationProtocolChecklist.action: Remove the water curtain, distribution tubes, float switch, and water trough. Scrub all slimy surfaces with an EPA-registered sanitizing solution (200 ppm available chlorine or quaternary ammonium) and non-metallic brushes.

sanitationProtocolChecklist.title: Chemical Biocide Circulation & Triple Potable Rinse
sanitationProtocolChecklist.action: Run manufacturer sanitation cycle with food-contact sanitizer for 10 minutes. Follow with three full cycles of clean potable water to purge all chemical biocide residues.

sanitationProtocolChecklist.title: Replace Water Filter Cartridge & Sanitize Storage Bin
sanitationProtocolChecklist.action: Install fresh sub-micron carbon filter cartridge. Wash, sanitize, and air-dry storage bin walls, drain pan, and ice scoop before returning to service.
